summary.intent: Clean up a meeting recording transcript, then verify whether escalation/approval requests actually show up in Maren's approver view in the Soony (ask_soony) app, without pushing anything.
summary.outcome: Transcript was cleaned into a summarized markdown file in Downloads. The escalation routing bug was found and fixed so all 23 escalated cases now reach Maren's 'Waiting for your OK' list; the fix has tests, passes the full suite (374), ruff and tsc, and was committed locally without pushing.

repo: Sign-off and escalation logic lives in src/ask_soony/signoff.py and src/ask_soony/api.py; the approver view is built in web/src/App.tsx, with Launch.tsx, LaunchBrief.tsx and Today.tsx naming the approver in the UI.
Routine cases owned by the buyer should be routed to the policy approver (Maren); cases with no named approver should be refused rather than silently dropped.
Probing behavior on a copied state directory allows end-to-end verification of escalation without touching real or deployed state; deployed state was only read with GET.
The repo contains confidential challenge data, so meeting transcripts and similar material should not be placed in it.

code.finding: Two regression tests added: buyer-owned routine case goes to policy approver, and a case with nobody named is refused. Sign-off suite now has 12 tests.
Escalate endpoint changed; a 409 response was dropped to fix two failing tests elsewhere that depended on the old behavior.

workflow: Commit is allowed but push is not; the user said not to push, so the fix was committed locally only.
When unrelated tests failed after a change, comparing against unchanged code confirmed whether the change caused them.
Speaker labels in the recording tool were unreliable, so speaker attribution in the cleaned transcript is a guess.
Run full tests, ruff and tsc before committing.

friction: Recording tool switched speakers mid-sentence, making speaker labels (S0-S6) unreliable.
Transcript had many mishearings (Soony, three-way match, ERP, ElevenLabs, Claude, Excel sheet) that needed manual correction.
Two tests outside the sign-off suite failed after the fix and required investigation, ending in removal of the 409 response.
The user's wording on commit/push was initially ambiguous ('not to commit') and was clarified mid-session to commit-but-don't-push.
open_items: Fix is committed locally but not pushed; push/PR is pending the user's go-ahead.
Speaker attribution in the cleaned transcript remains unreliable and may need manual review.
Questions still open from the meeting (listed at the end of the cleaned transcript summary) remain unresolved.
Dropping the 409 in the escalate endpoint may deserve a review to confirm the intended API behavior.
